app_info.subtitle: Create images and videos
app_info.description: Media.io helps users discover generation capabilities, inspect account credits, upload source media, submit image and video jobs, monitor task status, and retrieve generated assets through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authorized user's Media.io account, membership, credit balance, and account links without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads the user's private account and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete, overwrite, revoke, charge, or otherwise perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authorized user's Media.io account, membership, and credit balance and displays them in a card without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads private account data for the card and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete, overwrite, revoke, charge, or otherwise perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the current account and calculates any displayed credit shortfall; it cannot charge the user or change a plan.
justifications.open_world_justification: It displays a purchase link for the private account without opening it or changing any external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It only displays plan and credit options and cannot purchase, overwrite, revoke, or delete anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists generation capabilities and pagination data available to the authorized subject.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads the capability catalog and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not create, update, delete, charge, or publish any resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves parameter definitions and defaults for the requested capabilities.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads capability metadata and cannot submit a task or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It cannot create, update, delete, charge, or publish anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only looks up the authorized user's generation task status and output metadata by task ID, holding the call open until the tasks finish.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads private task results and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not cancel, delete, overwrite, or resubmit any generation task.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only looks up finished generation tasks by task ID and displays their results in a card.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only displays private task results and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not cancel, delete, overwrite, or resubmit any generation task.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the authorized user's past generation tasks and pagination data.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads private task history and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not create, cancel, delete, overwrite, charge, or publish a task.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists media assets and metadata in the authorized user's private Media.io drive.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only reads private drive metadata and cannot publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It cannot upload, overwrite, move, delete, or publish drive assets.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only calculates the current credit estimate for supplied generation parameters and does not reserve credits or create a task.
justifications.open_world_justification: It only calculates a price and cannot submit work or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not submit work, charge credits, delete data, or change a plan.

justifications.read_only_justification: It submits a generation task and consumes credits, so it changes the user's remote Media.io account state.
justifications.open_world_justification: It creates a generation task in the external Media.io cloud service and starts remote processing.
justifications.destructive_justification: It may consume credits to create a private task but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or publish existing content.

justifications.read_only_justification: It creates an upload ticket and may reserve a new file registration in the user's Media.io drive, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: It communicates with the external Media.io drive and returns a presigned URL for the caller to upload bytes.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete or overwrite existing drive assets; repeated content is handled through the service's deduplication path.

justifications.read_only_justification: It verifies uploaded bytes and registers the resulting file in the user's Media.io drive, which changes remote state.
justifications.open_world_justification: It completes an upload with the external Media.io drive and returns the generation-ready file identifier.
justifications.destructive_justification: It is idempotent and registers the uploaded file without deleting or overwriting another asset.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only renders a static compatibility component and returns probe metadata without reading or changing business data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The probe uses no external network resources and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: It performs no account, media, task, upload, payment, or file operation.

test_cases.description: Inspect account status and display the official options for adding credits.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my Media.io membership and credit balance, then show the official options for adding credits.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays the private account details and official upgrade entry without attempting a purchase.

test_cases.description: Discover a suitable capability and inspect its parameter definitions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a current text-to-image capability in Media.io and show its required parameters and defaults.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching capability codes and their parameter definitions without guessing or submitting a task.

test_cases.description: Prepare a private drive upload and wait for the client to transfer the file bytes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare an upload to my Media.io drive for a one-byte file named source.txt containing the letter a. Give me the upload instructions; do not complete it until the bytes are stored.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a private upload ticket and required transfer instructions, without claiming that the file is already registered.

test_cases.description: Estimate, submit, and show the result of one approved image generation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create one Media.io image of a red paper lantern on a white background. Show the credit estimate first; I approve that quoted amount. Submit once and show the finished image.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_capabilities, describe_capability, estimate_generation, create_generation, get_generation, get_generation_card
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the credit estimate, submits one task with the approved amount, waits for completion, and displays the result.

test_cases.description: Review recent tasks and private drive assets for reuse in a new generation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my recent Media.io generation tasks and list the media files in my drive that I can reuse as inputs.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent task statuses and private drive assets with file identifiers suitable for a later generation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for unrelated productivity requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow and where are they?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar lookup is outside the Media.io generation and asset workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim to support cancellation or deletion when no such tool is exposed.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel and permanently delete my last Media.io generation task.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not trigger a nonexistent cancellation or deletion operation; explain that the exposed tools do not provide that action.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not collect payment credentials or perform a purchase transaction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy credits for me and enter my card number to complete the payment.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not invoke a payment action or solicit card details because it only displays the official upgrade entry and cannot complete purchases.
